title: The Form-Filling Assistant in Chrome — Codex

intro.title: The Form-Filling Assistant
intro.subtitle: A caseworker's co-pilot in Chrome's side panel

outro.title: Fills verified values
outro.subtitle: Submission always stays with the caseworker

steps.say: This is the Nava Form-Filling Assistant. It works in Chrome's side panel, right next to the benefits application a caseworker has open.

steps.label: Open the application
steps.say: Here, a caseworker has started an application for a client.

steps.label: Bring in client data
steps.say: In the assistant, they bring in the client's information. For this demo, a fictional sample record.

steps.label: Analyze this form
steps.say: Then they ask the assistant to work on this tab.

steps.label: The application form
steps.say: Now Codex takes over through the user's subscription and a local companion. One agent maps each field, another looks for gaps, and an independent reviewer approves the plan before anything is typed.

steps.label: The reviewed plan
steps.say: Every value is checked before it's written, and the assistant never submits. The caseworker reviews the answers and sends the application.
